headline: The Restaurant & Hospitality Master 20
threshold: By Lesson 20, you can train new staff and have them teach a procedure back, handle overbookings, shortages and improper guest requests, give feedback and settle team conflicts, lead an incident or emergency response, and write the shift report in Spanish.

lessons.title: Explain the Room-Status Flow to a New Desk Agent
lessons.objective: Explain step by step how a room goes from dirty to inspected to ready, and why each step matters.

words.note: Common in Mexico for the housekeeper who cleans rooms; a man is el camarista.
Feminine noun that takes el because of the stressed a: el ama, las amas de llaves.
Staff often just say el sistema.
A man is el recepcionista.
A woman is la huésped or la huéspeda.
Standard hotel loanword; el check-in works the same way.

words.en: First the room attendant cleans the room and marks it in the system.
words.es: Primero la camarista limpia la habitación y la marca en el sistema.

words.en: Then the housekeeping supervisor inspects it.
words.es: Luego el ama de llaves la inspecciona.

words.en: That's why it isn't assigned until it's inspected.
words.es: Por eso no se asigna hasta que esté inspeccionada.

words.en: We do it this way because sometimes something is missing, like towels.
words.es: Lo hacemos así porque a veces falta algo, como toallas.

words.en: After the inspection, it changes to available in the PMS.
words.es: Después de la inspección, cambia a disponible en el PMS.

words.en: If you're unsure, call the housekeeping supervisor before assigning it.
words.es: Si tienes duda, llama al ama de llaves antes de asignarla.
words.note: Informal (tú), coworker to coworker.

words.en: Ma'am, your room will be ready in 20 minutes.
words.es: Señora, su habitación estará lista en 20 minutos.
words.note: Formal, to a guest.

words.en: Shall we hold your bags while you wait?
words.note: Formal (usted), to a guest.

lessons.speaking: You are the front desk manager, and the AI is Lucía, a new desk agent: explain step by step how a room goes from dirty to inspected to ready, and why each step matters, using primero, luego, después, porque and por eso.

grammar.focus: Connectors for sequence and cause (primero, luego, porque, por eso: primero la limpian, luego la inspeccionan, por eso no se asigna)

examples.es: Primero la limpian, luego la inspeccionan y después la liberan.
examples.en: First they clean it, then they inspect it, and after that they release it.

examples.es: Falta la inspección, por eso todavía no se asigna.
examples.en: The inspection is still pending, so it isn't assigned yet.

lessons.title: Why We Label and Rotate in the Walk-In
lessons.objective: Explain the walk-in's labeling and first-in, first-out system and the reasons behind it.

words.note: Many US kitchens just say el masking.
Common in Mexico; el estante and la repisa are also used.

words.en: Everything gets labeled here, no exceptions.
words.es: Aquí se etiqueta todo, sin excepción.

words.en: New stuff goes in back and old stuff in front.
words.es: Lo nuevo se pone atrás y lo viejo adelante.

words.en: If you always grab from the front, the oldest gets used first.
words.es: Si siempre agarras lo de adelante, se usa primero lo más viejo.
words.note: Informal (tú), to a coworker.

words.en: If it has no date, it gets thrown out per local rules.
words.es: Si no tiene fecha, se tira según la norma local.

words.en: Raw meat is always stored on the bottom shelf.
words.es: La carne cruda siempre se guarda en el anaquel de abajo.

words.en: Put the date, your initials and the product name on it.
words.es: Ponle la fecha, tus iniciales y el nombre del producto.
words.note: Informal command (tú).

words.en: If we leave it in back, it expires and goes to waste.
words.es: Si lo dejamos atrás, se vence y se desperdicia.

words.en: How many days does it keep, according to the local health code?
words.es: ¿Cuántos días dura, según el reglamento sanitario local?

lessons.speaking: You are the kitchen manager, and the AI is Andrés, a prep cook: explain the walk-in labeling and first-in, first-out system and the reasons behind it, using impersonal se (se etiqueta, se pone atrás) and si + present (si no tiene fecha, se tira).

grammar.focus: Impersonal se; si + present for general truths (se etiqueta todo; si no tiene fecha, se descarta según la norma local)

examples.es: Se etiqueta todo con fecha e iniciales.
examples.en: Everything is labeled with the date and initials.

examples.es: Si un recipiente no tiene etiqueta, no se usa.
examples.en: If a container has no label, it doesn't get used.

lessons.title: Training a New Dishwasher on the Chemical Station
lessons.objective: Give clear step-by-step commands at the dish machine and have the new dishwasher teach the routine back.

words.note: Also called la máquina de platos.
Short for hoja de datos de seguridad.
Loanword common in US kitchens.
Informal (tú), to a coworker.

words.es: Léela en voz alta, por favor.
words.note: La = la etiqueta. Pronoun attaches to the command: léela.

words.en: Put them on before opening any bottle.
words.es: Póntelos antes de abrir cualquier botella.
words.note: Los = los guantes; the accent keeps the stress: póntelos.

words.en: The dilution is done according to the manufacturer's label.
words.es: La dilución se hace según la etiqueta del fabricante.

words.en: Close it tight and put it back in its place.
words.es: Ciérralo bien y guárdalo en su lugar.

words.en: Test it with a test strip before washing.
words.es: Mídelo con la tira de prueba antes de lavar.

words.en: If it splashes you, rinse at the eyewash station and tell me.
words.es: Si te salpica, enjuágate en el lavaojos y avísame.

words.en: Now you explain it to me, step by step.
words.es: Ahora explícamelo tú, paso a paso.

lessons.speaking: You are the banquet kitchen manager, and the AI is Wilmer, a new dishwasher: walk him through the chemical station step by step with commands like léela, póntelos, no los mezcles and ciérralo bien, then have him teach the routine back to you.

grammar.focus: Commands with object pronouns (léela, póntelos, no los mezcles, ciérralo bien)

examples.es: Léela antes de abrir la botella.
examples.en: Read it before you open the bottle.

examples.es: No los mezcles; ciérralos y sepáralos.
examples.en: Don't mix them; close them and keep them apart.

lessons.title: Read the Supplier Allergen Sheet Before Menu Launch
lessons.objective: Read a supplier's allergen spec sheet and explain to servers what must change before service.

words.note: Common in Mexico; el marañón or el anacardo elsewhere.
Label wording for possible traces; treat it as a real allergen risk.

words.en: According to the supplier's sheet, the pesto contains cashews.
words.es: Según la ficha del proveedor, el pesto lleva nuez de la India.

words.en: Camila, read me the allergen statement, please.
words.es: Camila, léeme la declaración de alérgenos, por favor.
words.note: Informal (tú), to the server lead.

words.en: Before opening, we have to change all the printed menus.
words.es: Antes de abrir, hay que cambiar todas las cartas impresas.

words.en: Before taking the order, always ask about allergies.
words.es: Antes de tomar la orden, pregunten siempre por alergias.
words.note: Plural ustedes command, to the server team.

words.en: If a guest asks, tell them the pesto does contain nuts.
words.es: Si un cliente pregunta, díganle que el pesto sí lleva nueces.

words.en: Don't promise any substitution without confirming with the chef.
words.es: No prometan ninguna sustitución sin confirmar con el chef.

words.en: After talking with the chef, we'll update the allergen chart.
words.es: Después de hablar con el chef, actualizamos la tabla de alérgenos.

words.en: Chef, do we have a nut-free pesto for tonight?
words.es: Chef, ¿tenemos un pesto sin nueces para esta noche?

lessons.speaking: You are the restaurant manager, and the AI is Camila, the server lead: read the new pesto's supplier spec sheet together, explain what it says, and tell her what must change before service, using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que.

grammar.focus: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que (antes de abrir hay que corregir la carta)

examples.es: Antes de abrir, hay que corregir la tabla de alérgenos.
examples.en: Before opening, we have to correct the allergen chart.

examples.es: Después de leer la ficha, hay que avisar a todos los meseros.
examples.en: After reading the sheet, we have to let all the servers know.

lessons.title: Oversold Night: Walking a Guest to a Partner Hotel
lessons.objective: Explain what went wrong with a confirmed booking and propose a night at a partner hotel with transport.

words.note: Hotels sell a few rooms over capacity, expecting some guests not to arrive.
Moving a booked guest to another hotel.
For a woman, use the feminine form with la and nocturna.

words.en: Mr. Ibáñez, your reservation was confirmed; the mistake was ours.
words.es: Señor Ibáñez, su reservación sí estaba confirmada; el error fue nuestro.
words.note: Formal: use usted with the guest.

words.en: The system kept selling when there were no rooms left.
words.es: El sistema siguió vendiendo cuando ya no quedaban habitaciones.

words.en: I'm very sorry; I know you're coming from a long trip.
words.es: Lo siento mucho; sé que viene de un viaje largo.
words.note: Formal.

words.en: I would offer you a room at the Hotel Mirador, at no cost to you.
words.es: Le ofrecería una habitación en el Hotel Mirador, sin costo para usted.
words.note: The conditional softens the proposal; formal.

words.en: We would pay for the taxi there and back.
words.es: Nosotros pagaríamos el taxi de ida y vuelta.

words.en: Tomorrow at 8 we'll bring you back for your meeting.
words.es: Mañana a las 8 lo traemos de regreso para su junta.
words.note: Formal: the pronoun lo means you, for a man.

words.en: Call the Mirador and confirm the room, please.
words.es: Marca al Mirador y confirma la habitación, porfa.
words.note: Informal, to a desk coworker. In Mexico, marcar means to phone.

lessons.speaking: You are the night manager at Hotel Las Palmas, and the AI is Gerardo Ibáñez, a tired guest with a confirmed reservation: explain what went wrong with the preterite and imperfect (el sistema aceptó…, ya estábamos llenos) and propose the partner hotel and transport with le ofrecería…

grammar.focus: Preterite vs imperfect; conditional for the proposal (el sistema aceptó la reserva cuando ya estábamos llenos; le ofrecería…)

examples.es: Cuando usted reservó, el sistema todavía mostraba cuartos libres.
examples.en: When you booked, the system was still showing free rooms.

examples.es: Le ofrecería la noche en el hotel asociado con el desayuno incluido.
examples.en: I would offer you the night at the partner hotel with breakfast included.

lessons.title: Half the Sea Bass Didn't Come: Changing the Menu
lessons.objective: Agree on a substitute fish with the chef and explain how tonight's menu will change and compare.

words.note: Mexican name; other countries say pargo rojo.
The courses of a tasting menu are called tiempos.

words.en: Nicolás, how many pounds of sea bass are you going to send us today?
words.es: Nicolás, ¿cuántas libras de robalo nos va a mandar hoy?
words.note: Formal: use usted with the supplier rep.

words.en: Can you send me the rest first thing tomorrow?
words.es: ¿Me puede mandar el resto mañana a primera hora?
words.note: Formal.

words.en: Teresa, we're going to use corvina in the second course.
words.es: Teresa, vamos a usar corvina en el segundo tiempo.
words.note: Informal: use tú with the chef.

words.en: Corvina holds up on the griddle better than sea bass.
words.es: La corvina aguanta mejor la plancha que el robalo.

words.en: Will you taste it before 5 to adjust the sauce?
words.es: ¿La pruebas antes de las 5 para ajustar la salsa?
words.note: Informal.

words.en: The tasting menu will cost the same as always.
words.es: El menú de degustación costará lo mismo que siempre.

words.en: At the meeting I'll explain the change to the servers.
words.es: En la junta les explicaré el cambio a los meseros.

lessons.speaking: You are the manager of Marisquería El Faro, and the AI is chef Teresa Llorente: agree on a substitute fish for the tasting menu, then explain the changes with vamos a…, the future (será, costará) and comparisons like más firme que and tan fresca como.

grammar.focus: Future and ir a; comparisons (vamos a usar corvina; es más firme que la lubina y tan fresca como…)

examples.es: Vamos a usar corvina y va a llevar la misma salsa.
examples.en: We're going to use corvina, and it's going to have the same sauce.

examples.es: Esta corvina es tan fresca como el robalo, pero más firme.
examples.en: This corvina is as fresh as the sea bass, but firmer.

lessons.title: Wedding Planner Brings 22 Extra Guests
lessons.objective: Recount the agreed numbers to an outside planner and work out seats, plates and charges on the spot.

words.en: Ms. Saldaña, in the contract you signed for 140 guests.
words.es: Señora Saldaña, en el contrato usted firmó por 140 invitados.
words.note: Formal: use usted with the outside planner.

words.en: On Thursday you confirmed the final count by email.
words.es: El jueves usted confirmó el número final por correo.

words.en: Esteban, how many more round tables fit next to the dance floor?
words.es: Esteban, ¿cuántas mesas redondas más caben junto a la pista?
words.note: Informal: use tú with the banquet captain.

words.en: Esteban, bring out 22 more chairs from storage.
words.es: Esteban, saca 22 sillas más de la bodega.
words.note: Informal.

words.en: According to the room permit, the maximum capacity is 180 people.
words.es: Según el permiso del salón, la capacidad máxima es de 180 personas.

words.en: The 22 extra place settings are charged at the per-person price.
words.es: Los 22 cubiertos adicionales se cobran al precio por persona.

words.en: I'll prepare the extra charge so you can sign it today.
words.es: Le preparo el cargo adicional para que lo firme hoy.
words.note: Formal; the verb after the phrase meaning 'so that' is always subjunctive.

lessons.speaking: You are the banquet manager at Hotel Real Alameda, and the AI is wedding planner Verónica Saldaña: recount the signed numbers in the preterite (firmamos 140, llegaron 162) and work out extra tables, place settings and the extra charge with her.

grammar.focus: Preterite narration; numbers under pressure (firmamos 140, llegaron 162, faltan 22 cubiertos)

examples.es: Firmamos 140 cubiertos y esta noche llegaron 162.
examples.en: We signed for 140 place settings, and tonight 162 arrived.

examples.es: El jueves usted confirmó 140 y no mandó ningún cambio.
examples.en: On Thursday you confirmed 140 and didn't send any change.

lessons.title: Saying No to One More Round
lessons.objective: Refuse service to an intoxicated guest firmly and kindly, and instruct the bartender what not to do.

words.note: Common Mexican word; use it with staff, never to the guest's face.
Formal term used in policies and reports.
Brand name used for any rideshare.
Mexican word for snacks served with drinks.
For a woman, use la guardia de seguridad.

words.en: Joaquín, don't pour that round; give him a glass of water.
words.es: Joaquín, no le pongas esa ronda; dale un vaso de agua.
words.note: Informal: use tú with the bartender.

words.en: Don't give him the keys; wait until I talk to him.
words.es: No le des las llaves; espera a que yo hable con él.
words.note: Informal.

words.en: Don Ramiro, we can't serve you any more tonight.
words.es: Don Ramiro, por esta noche ya no le podemos servir.
words.note: Formal. Don before a first name shows respect to an older man.

words.en: You've been a customer for years, and we want you to get home safely.
words.es: Usted es cliente de años, y queremos que llegue bien.
words.note: Formal.

words.en: I don't recommend you drive; I'll get you a taxi.
words.es: No recomiendo que se vaya manejando; le pido un taxi.
words.note: Formal; the verb after this phrase of advice goes in the subjunctive.

words.en: The house will pay for your Uber home.
words.es: La casa le paga el Uber hasta su casa.

words.en: Do you want us to call someone in your family?
words.es: ¿Quiere que llamemos a alguien de su familia?
words.note: Formal; use the personal a before a person as the object.

words.en: Write down what happened in the log before closing.
words.es: Anota en el registro lo que pasó antes de cerrar.
words.note: Informal.

lessons.speaking: You are the manager at the Terraza Ocho rooftop bar, and the AI is Ramiro Ortega, a regular who has had too much: refuse more drinks firmly and kindly with no recomiendo que + subjunctive, offer him a ride, and tell bartender Joaquín what not to do with negative commands like no le sirvas.

grammar.focus: Negative commands; subjunctive after no recomiendo que (no le sirvas más; no recomiendo que maneje esta noche)

examples.es: No le sirvas más y no le cobres otra ronda.
examples.en: Don't serve him any more, and don't charge him for another round.

examples.es: No recomiendo que tome otra copa; mejor le traigo botana.
examples.en: I don't recommend you have another drink; I'll bring you some snacks instead.

lessons.title: Feedback for a Server Who Skipped the Allergy Question
lessons.objective: Give private, specific feedback about a missed allergy question and agree on what the server will do next.

words.note: The flag the server writes on the ticket so the kitchen sees it.
Stress on the second-to-last syllable: a-na-fi-LAK-sia.
Used with estar or ponerse: se puso a la defensiva.

words.en: Marisol, do you have a minute to talk in private?
words.es: Marisol, ¿tienes un minuto para hablar en privado?
words.note: Informal: tú with a coworker you supervise.

words.en: Today you didn't ask about allergies at two tables.
words.es: Hoy no preguntaste por alergias en dos mesas.

words.en: I understand you were alone and had a heavy workload.
words.es: Entiendo que estabas sola y con mucha carga de trabajo.

words.en: Even so, I want you to ask about allergies at every table.
words.es: Aun así, quiero que preguntes por alergias en cada mesa.

words.en: I recommend you write it on the ticket as an allergy note.
words.es: Te recomiendo que lo anotes en la comanda como nota de alergia.

words.en: If you end up alone, I'd rather you call me so I can help you.
words.es: Si te quedas sola, prefiero que me llames para que te ayude.

words.en: This isn't a scolding; an allergy can send someone to the hospital.
words.es: No es un regaño; una alergia puede mandar a alguien al hospital.

words.en: What do you need from me so it doesn't happen again?
words.es: ¿Qué necesitas de mí para que no vuelva a pasar?

lessons.speaking: You are the manager at Café Alborada, and the AI is server Marisol Vega: in private, give specific feedback on the two tables where she skipped the allergy question and agree on next steps with quiero que preguntes and te recomiendo que lo anotes.

grammar.focus: Present subjunctive after wishes and recommendations (quiero que preguntes en cada mesa; te recomiendo que lo anotes)

examples.es: Quiero que preguntes por alergias en cada mesa, aunque estés sola.
examples.en: I want you to ask about allergies at every table, even if you're alone.

examples.es: Te recomiendo que lo anotes en la comanda antes de mandarla.
examples.en: I recommend you write it on the ticket before you send it.

lessons.title: Line Cook vs. Server: Who Said What About the Steak
lessons.objective: Retell both sides of an argument over a remade steak and settle it with a fair agreement.

words.note: Mexican doneness scale; bien cocido is well-done.
Capturar la orden = enter the order in the POS (common Mexican usage).

words.en: Héctor, tell me your version without interrupting, please.
words.es: Héctor, cuéntame tu versión sin interrumpir, por favor.
words.note: Informal: tú with a crew member.

words.en: Daniela said the customer wanted the rib eye medium-well.
words.es: Daniela dijo que el cliente quería el rib eye tres cuartos.

words.en: Héctor said the ticket said medium.
words.es: Héctor dijo que la comanda decía término medio.

words.en: You both said the kitchen was slammed and it was loud.
words.es: Los dos dijeron que la cocina estaba llena y había ruido.

words.en: Nobody yells at anybody here, not even during the rush.
words.es: Aquí nadie le grita a nadie, ni en hora pico.

words.en: From today on, if there's any doubt, the doneness gets confirmed at the pass.
words.es: Desde hoy, si hay duda, se confirma el término en el pase.

words.en: Daniela, check what you entered before sending the order.
words.es: Daniela, revisa lo que capturaste antes de mandar la orden.

words.en: Does that seem fair to both of you?

lessons.speaking: You are the manager at Asador Los Robles, and the AI is grill cook Héctor Salinas and server Daniela Cruz: hear both versions of the steak argument, retell each side with dijo que and the imperfect (la cocina estaba llena), and settle it with a fair agreement.

grammar.focus: Reported speech; imperfect for background (Héctor dijo que la comanda decía término medio; la cocina estaba llena)

examples.es: Héctor dijo que él solo seguía lo que decía la comanda.
examples.en: Héctor said he was just following what the ticket said.

examples.es: Daniela explicó que el cliente estaba molesto y que ella tenía cuatro mesas.
examples.en: Daniela explained that the customer was upset and that she had four tables.

lessons.title: Keep Housekeeping Going Through a Sold-Out Weekend
lessons.objective: Recognize a tired team's effort and make concrete commitments to get them through the weekend.

words.note: Mexican usage for documented sick leave; estar de incapacidad = be out sick.
Common Mexican term for the posted schedule.

words.en: Rosa, thanks for telling me; I know your team is exhausted.
words.es: Rosa, gracias por avisarme; sé que su equipo está agotado.
words.note: Formal: usted with the supervisor.

words.en: Tomorrow you'll have two more people from the agency.
words.es: Mañana tendrán dos personas más de la agencia.
words.note: Ustedes form, to the whole team.

words.en: We'll lower the quota to 12 rooms per person until Monday.
words.es: Bajaremos la cuota a 12 habitaciones por persona hasta el lunes.

words.en: The deep cleanings will wait until Tuesday.
words.es: Las limpiezas profundas se quedarán para el martes.

words.en: On Saturday the hotel will pay for everyone's lunch.
words.es: El sábado el hotel les pagará la comida a todos.

words.en: Everyone will get their full break, even if there are late checkouts.
words.es: Cada quien tendrá su descanso completo, aunque haya salidas tardías.

words.en: What's weighing on you the most right now?
words.es: ¿Qué es lo que más les pesa ahora mismo?
words.note: Informal and warm, to the team.

words.en: You've kept this hotel going; we'll get through it together.
words.es: Ustedes han sacado este hotel adelante; lo vamos a lograr juntos.

lessons.speaking: You are the manager at Hotel Brisa Marina, and the AI is housekeeping supervisor Rosa Delgado: ask how the team is holding up, recognize their effort, and make concrete weekend commitments with the future (tendrán, bajaremos) and lo vamos a lograr juntos.

grammar.focus: Future for commitments; encouragement register (mañana tendrán dos personas más; lo vamos a lograr juntos)

examples.es: El lunes les daré un día libre a quienes trabajaron los tres días.
examples.en: On Monday I'll give a day off to those who worked all three days.

examples.es: Hablaré con recepción y limitaremos las salidas tardías.
examples.en: I'll talk to the front desk and we'll limit late checkouts.

lessons.title: Walk-In Failure: Telling Owner, Chef, Guest and Crew
lessons.objective: Explain one cooler failure in the right register to four different listeners and have the crew teach back the new check.

words.note: For a dish you can't serve today: el cordero está agotado.

words.en: Don Alfonso, I'd like to inform you that the walk-in failed last night.
words.es: Don Alfonso, quisiera informarle que el walk-in falló anoche.
words.note: Formal: usted and don with the owner.

words.en: Pilar, I already called the technician; he gets here at 11.
words.es: Pilar, ya llamé al técnico; llega a las 11.
words.note: Informal: tú with the chef as a peer.

words.en: Pilar, if there's any doubt about a product, we throw it out.
words.es: Pilar, si hay duda con algún producto, lo tiramos.

words.en: Doña Inés, I'm sorry to tell you the lamb is unavailable today.
words.es: Doña Inés, lamento decirle que hoy el cordero está agotado.
words.note: Formal: usted and doña with a regular guest.

words.en: May I recommend another dish from the chef?
words.es: ¿Me permite recomendarle otro platillo del chef?
words.note: Formal softener for a guest.

words.en: Kevin, you check the thermometer at opening and write it in the log.
words.es: Kevin, revisa el termómetro tú al abrir y anótalo en el registro.
words.note: Informal: tú with a crew member.

words.en: If the temperature goes past the limit the local code sets, tell me.
words.es: Si la temperatura pasa del límite que marca el reglamento local, avísame.

words.en: Kevin, can you show me how you'll do the check tomorrow?
words.es: Kevin, ¿me enseñas cómo vas a hacer la revisión mañana?

lessons.speaking: You are the manager at Casa Olmo, and the AI is owner Alfonso Medina, chef Pilar Gómez, guest Inés Carvajal and dishwasher Kevin Ramos: explain the walk-in failure in each one's register (quisiera informarle with usted, tú with the crew), then have Kevin teach back the new temperature check.

grammar.focus: Usted / tú switching; softeners (quisiera informarle, don Alfonso; Kevin, revisa el termómetro tú)

examples.es: Quisiera informarle, don Alfonso, que perdimos producto por la falla.
examples.en: I'd like to inform you, Don Alfonso, that we lost product because of the failure.

examples.es: Kevin, revisa tú la sonda y anota la hora en el registro.
examples.en: Kevin, you check the probe and write the time in the log.

lessons.title: Fryer Burn: Interview and Incident Report
lessons.objective: Interview the injured cook and a witness, then narrate the incident in order for the written report.

words.note: Use la testigo for a woman and el testigo for a man.
In US and Mexican workplaces, people say reporte more often than informe.

words.en: Óscar, tell me what happened, from the beginning.
words.es: Óscar, cuéntame qué pasó, desde el principio.
words.note: Informal (tú) with a coworker.

words.en: What time did you open the drain valve?
words.es: ¿A qué hora abriste la válvula de drenaje?

words.en: Were you wearing the heat-resistant gloves at that moment?
words.es: ¿Traías puestos los guantes térmicos en ese momento?
words.note: Informal. Ask it in a calm, neutral tone, as a fact for the report, not as blame.

words.en: Brenda, what did you see right before the burn?
words.es: Brenda, ¿qué viste justo antes de la quemadura?
words.note: Informal (tú) with a coworker.

words.en: At 9:40, Óscar started draining the fryer.
words.es: A las 9:40, Óscar empezó a vaciar la freidora.

words.en: While the oil was draining, the bucket moved and splashed him.
words.es: Mientras escurría el aceite, la cubeta se movió y lo salpicó.

words.en: Right after that, Brenda put his arm under cold water.
words.es: Justo después, Brenda le puso el brazo bajo agua fría.

words.en: A few minutes later, I took him to the urgent care clinic.
words.es: Unos minutos más tarde, lo llevé a la clínica de urgencias.

lessons.speaking: You are the manager, and the AI is line cook Óscar Méndez: interview him about his fryer burn, ask what happened and when, then read the events back in order for the report using time markers like a las 9:40, mientras escurría el aceite and justo después.

grammar.focus: Past narration with time markers (a las 9:40, mientras escurría el aceite, justo después, unos minutos más tarde)

examples.es: A las 9:40 Óscar abrió la válvula, y justo después gritó.
examples.en: At 9:40 Óscar opened the valve, and right after that he shouted.

examples.es: Mientras él escurría el aceite, Brenda limpiaba la plancha.
examples.en: While he was draining the oil, Brenda was cleaning the griddle.

lessons.title: Near Miss: The Shrimp Almost Reached the Allergic Guest
lessons.objective: Talk through an allergy near miss without blame and agree on a change that stops it from happening again.

words.note: Safety term for a near miss; you will also hear cuasi accidente.
Common loanword in US kitchens.

words.en: This meeting isn't about finding who's to blame, but causes.
words.es: Esta junta no es para buscar culpables, sino causas.
words.note: Informal team tone; say it first to set a no-blame frame.

words.en: Iván, how did you notice the dish had shrimp?
words.es: Iván, ¿cómo te diste cuenta de que el plato llevaba camarón?
words.note: Informal (tú) with a coworker.

words.en: The aguachile almost went out to table 7.
words.es: Por poco sale el aguachile a la mesa 7.

words.en: If Iván hadn't asked, the guest could have ended up in the hospital.
words.es: Si Iván no preguntaba, la clienta podría haber terminado en el hospital.
words.note: Si + imperfect is common in speech; the formal version is si no hubiera preguntado.

words.en: Lorena, did the ticket you got say anything about an allergy?
words.es: Lorena, ¿la comanda que te llegó decía algo de alergia?

words.en: We almost sent it because the modifier didn't print.
words.es: Casi lo mandamos porque el modificador no se imprimió.

words.en: From today on, every allergy is confirmed out loud at the pass.
words.es: Desde hoy, toda alergia se confirma en voz alta en el pase.

words.en: How about we try this change for one week?
words.es: ¿Les parece si probamos este cambio por una semana?

lessons.speaking: You are the manager, and the AI is runner Iván Soto at the morning debrief: talk through the shrimp near miss without blame, ask how it was caught, describe what almost happened with por poco, casi and podría haber, and agree on one change.

grammar.focus: Casi, por poco, podría haber; si clauses (por poco sale el plato; si no lo veía Iván, podría haber pasado algo grave)

examples.es: Por poco sale el plato sin revisar la alergia.
examples.en: The dish almost went out without the allergy being checked.

examples.es: Si Lorena no lo veía, podría haber llegado a la mesa.
examples.en: If Lorena hadn't seen it, it could have reached the table.

lessons.title: Gas Smell During Breakfast: Stop Service and Evacuate
lessons.objective: Stop cooking, give short radio commands, evacuate the kitchen and call for help following the hotel protocol.

words.note: In Mexico la estufa is the range or stove; the oven is el horno.

words.en: Stop cooking and get out to the meeting point now!
words.es: ¡Dejen de cocinar y salgan ya al punto de reunión!
words.note: Plural ustedes command to the crew.

words.en: Don't touch the switches or turn anything on.
words.es: No toquen los interruptores ni prendan nada.

words.en: Fabián, if it's safe, shut off the gas valve.
words.es: Fabián, si es seguro, cierra la llave del gas.
words.note: Informal (tú) with a coworker.

words.en: Natalia, this is the manager: there's a gas smell in the kitchen.
words.es: Natalia, habla el gerente: hay olor a gas en cocina.
words.note: Radio style: say who is talking first, then the problem.

words.en: Call the gas company and 911, following the protocol.
words.es: Llama a la compañía de gas y al 911, según el protocolo.

words.en: If we wait for the smell to reach the dining room, it will be too late; we'll get the guests out now.
words.es: Si esperamos a que el olor llegue al comedor, será tarde; sacaremos a los huéspedes ahora.

words.en: Ladies and gentlemen, for your safety, please exit through this door.
words.es: Señores, por su seguridad, les pedimos salir por esta puerta.
words.note: Formal, for guests.

words.en: Nobody will go in until the firefighters allow it.
words.es: Nadie entrará hasta que los bomberos lo autoricen.

lessons.speaking: You are the breakfast manager, and the AI is front desk agent Natalia Ibarra on the radio: stop the cooking, order the crew out with short commands like salgan ya and no toquen los interruptores, and have her call for help per the hotel protocol using si + future.

grammar.focus: Si + present → future; short radio or phone commands (si huele a gas, saldremos; no toquen los interruptores; salgan ya)

examples.es: Si los bomberos lo piden, evacuaremos todo el comedor.
examples.en: If the firefighters ask, we'll evacuate the whole dining room.

examples.es: No usen el celular aquí adentro; salgan ya.
examples.en: Don't use your phone in here; get out now.

lessons.title: Health Inspector on the Line During Lunch
lessons.objective: Answer a health inspector formally, show the logs and explain how each procedure is carried out.

words.note: In US kitchens you will also hear el sanitizer.
Usually said and written as ppm (pe pe eme).
Often shortened to el cuaternario, like quat in English.
Common Mexican word for a written log or logbook.
For a woman, la encargada de turno.

words.en: Good afternoon, Inspector Benítez; we'll gladly show you the log.
words.es: Buenas tardes, inspector Benítez; con gusto le mostramos la bitácora.
words.note: Formal (usted).

words.en: The concentration is measured every 2 hours, according to our procedure.
words.es: La concentración se mide cada 2 horas, según nuestro procedimiento.

words.en: Each result is recorded on this sheet with the time and a signature.
words.es: Cada resultado se registra en esta hoja con hora y firma.

words.en: The solution is prepared according to the manufacturer's label.
words.es: La solución se prepara según la etiqueta del fabricante.

words.en: You're right, it's below what the label indicates.
words.es: Tiene razón, está por debajo de lo que indica la etiqueta.
words.note: Formal. Admit the result plainly, without excuses.

words.en: Samuel, please make a new bucket and test it again.
words.es: Samuel, por favor prepara una cubeta nueva y mídela otra vez.
words.note: Informal (tú) with the chef, still polite in front of the inspector.

words.en: Could you tell me how you'd like us to document the corrective action?
words.es: ¿Me podría indicar cómo quiere que documentemos la acción correctiva?
words.note: Formal (usted).

words.en: From today on, it will be checked at every shift change.
words.es: Desde hoy, se revisará en cada cambio de turno.

lessons.speaking: You are the kitchen manager, and the AI is health inspector Arturo Benítez: greet him formally with usted, show him the sanitizer log, and explain each step of the procedure with passive se (se mide, se registra, se prepara).

grammar.focus: Formal register; passive se for procedures (se mide la concentración cada dos horas; se registra en esta hoja)

examples.es: Se mide la concentración cada 2 horas, según nuestro procedimiento.
examples.en: The concentration is measured every 2 hours, according to our procedure.

examples.es: Si sale baja, se tira la solución y se prepara otra.
examples.en: If it tests low, the solution is thrown out and a new one is made.

lessons.title: Writing the Manager's Log After a Rough Night
lessons.objective: Write a clear manager's log covering a comped room, an elevator outage and a staff no-show.

words.note: Use la for a woman (Patricia), el gerente general for a man.
Used for an employee who misses a shift without calling.
In Mexican hotels, the guest's account or bill number.
Common in Mexico for to-dos still waiting to be done.

words.en: First, a free night was authorized in room 312.
words.es: En primer lugar, se autorizó una noche sin cargo en la 312.
words.note: Written register: se + verb hides who acted and sounds neutral.

words.en: In addition, the elevator was out of service from 7 on.
words.es: Además, el elevador estuvo fuera de servicio desde las 7.

words.en: As a result, the staff carried the luggage up the stairs.
words.es: Como consecuencia, el personal subió el equipaje por las escaleras.

words.en: However, there were no formal complaints from the affected guests.
words.es: Sin embargo, no hubo quejas formales de los huéspedes afectados.

words.en: Finally, the night-shift bellman missed his shift without calling.
words.es: Por último, el botones del turno de noche faltó sin avisar.

words.en: Raúl, what amount shows up for you in the system?
words.es: Raúl, ¿qué monto te aparece a ti en el sistema?
words.note: Informal tú between coworkers.

words.en: Send me the folio and I'll fix the adjustment before sending it.
words.es: Pásame el folio y corrijo el ajuste antes de enviarlo.
words.note: Informal tú.

words.en: Patricia, I'm attaching the shift report and the open items.
words.es: Patricia, le adjunto el reporte de turno y los pendientes.
words.note: Formal usted (le) with the general manager.

lessons.speaking: You are the manager of Hotel Vista Lago, and the AI is Raúl Cordero, the night auditor: write the log for Patricia Lozano on the comped room, the elevator outage and the staff no-show, using en primer lugar, además, sin embargo, como consecuencia and por último.

grammar.focus: Written register; report connectors (en primer lugar, además, sin embargo, como consecuencia, por último)

examples.es: En primer lugar, el elevador estuvo fuera de servicio 3 horas.
examples.en: First, the elevator was out of service for 3 hours.

examples.es: Sin embargo, el monto del ajuste no coincide con el de la auditoría nocturna.
examples.en: However, the adjustment amount does not match the one in the night audit.

lessons.title: Calls and Texts: Client Moves Her Anniversary Dinner
lessons.objective: Handle a client's call and texts to move a private dinner, confirm terms and update the chef.

words.note: El anticipo is also common in Mexico.

words.en: Restaurante El Patio, good afternoon, how may I help you?
words.es: Restaurante El Patio, buenas tardes, ¿en qué le puedo servir?
words.note: Formal phone greeting.

words.en: Would Saturday the 14th at 7 p.m. work for you?
words.es: ¿Le vendría bien el sábado 14 a las 7 de la noche?
words.note: Formal; the conditional softens the offer.

words.en: We could keep your full deposit for the new date.
words.es: Podríamos mantener su depósito completo para la nueva fecha.

words.en: Could you send me the changes by text, please?
words.es: ¿Me podría mandar los cambios por mensaje, por favor?

words.en: Mrs. Aguilar, confirming: Saturday the 14th, 40 guests, private room.
words.es: Sra. Aguilar, le confirmo: sábado 14, 40 invitados, salón privado.
words.note: Text style: short, with Sra. and usted (le) kept.

words.en: Under our policy, the date change has no penalty.
words.es: Según nuestra política, el cambio de fecha no tiene penalización.

words.en: Sorry, the call dropped; can you hear me well now?
words.es: Disculpe, se cortó la llamada; ¿me escucha bien ahora?

words.en: Gustavo, the Aguilar dinner moves to Saturday the 14th, does that work for you?
words.es: Gustavo, la cena Aguilar se pasa al sábado 14, ¿te queda bien?
words.note: Informal tú with the chef.

lessons.speaking: You are the events manager at Restaurante El Patio, and the AI is client Montserrat Aguilar: take her call to move her 40-guest anniversary dinner, offer dates with ¿le vendría bien…?, explain the deposit with podríamos…, confirm by text and message chef Gustavo.

grammar.focus: Phone and text conventions; conditional politeness (¿le vendría bien el sábado?; podríamos mantener el depósito)

examples.es: ¿Le vendría bien el sábado a las 7 p. m.?
examples.en: Would Saturday at 7 p.m. work for you?

examples.es: Podríamos mantener el depósito si nos confirma hoy.
examples.en: We could keep the deposit if you confirm with us today.

lessons.title: Post-Event Walkthrough with a Corporate Client
lessons.objective: Walk the venue with the client, discuss damage and a disputed bar tab, and offer conditional solutions.

words.en: Mr. Villalobos, thank you for doing the walkthrough with me.
words.es: Licenciado Villalobos, gracias por hacer el recorrido conmigo.
words.note: Formal; Licenciado is a common title for a professional in Mexico.

words.en: This scratch on the wooden floor wasn't there before the event.
words.es: Este rayón en el piso de madera no estaba antes del evento.

words.en: I understand your frustration; let's go over the bar consumption together.
words.es: Entiendo su molestia; revisemos juntos el consumo de barra.

words.en: We would take 10% off the bar as long as you sign today.
words.es: Le descontaríamos el 10% de la barra siempre que firme hoy.
words.note: Siempre que meaning 'as long as' takes the subjunctive (firme).

words.en: If the cameras showed something else, we wouldn't charge you for the repair.
words.es: Si las cámaras mostraran otra cosa, no le cobraríamos la reparación.

words.en: Under the contract, damages are covered by the security deposit.
words.es: Según el contrato, los daños se cubren con el depósito en garantía.

words.en: Provided you confirm today, we would send you the invoice tomorrow.
words.es: Con tal de que confirme hoy, le enviaríamos la factura mañana.
words.note: Con tal de que always takes the subjunctive (confirme).

words.en: Here are the opened bottles we counted at close.
words.es: Aquí tiene las botellas abiertas que contamos al cierre.

lessons.speaking: You are the manager of Hacienda San Telmo, and the AI is Ricardo Villalobos, the corporate client: walk the venue with him, review the open-bar total and the dance-floor scratch, and offer solutions with the conditional plus siempre que and con tal de que.

grammar.focus: Conditional; subjunctive in conditions (siempre que, con tal de que: le descontaríamos la barra siempre que firme hoy)

examples.es: Le descontaríamos 1 hora de barra siempre que firme hoy.
examples.en: We would take 1 hour off the bar tab as long as you sign today.

examples.es: No le cobraríamos el piso con tal de que las cámaras muestren que no fue su grupo.
examples.en: We wouldn't charge you for the floor, provided the cameras show it wasn't your group.

lessons.title: Capstone: A Sold-Out Saturday at Los Almendros
lessons.objective: Lead a full hard day in Spanish: teach, solve problems, manage people, handle a safety issue and report.

words.note: Many US restaurants also just say el host.
Ajonjolí is the usual word in Mexico; sésamo is more common in Spain.
Informal; for a report, use la discusión.
Use la dueña for a woman (Elena), el dueño for a man.

words.en: Tomás, greet them first and then check the waitlist.
words.es: Tomás, saluda primero y luego revisa la lista de espera.
words.note: Informal tú commands with a new coworker.

words.en: Check the menu: there's no guacamole tonight because we're out of avocado.
words.es: Revisen la carta: hoy no hay guacamole por falta de aguacate.
words.note: Ustedes command to the crew.

words.en: Before serving it, confirm with the chef that it has no sesame.
words.es: Antes de servirlo, confirmen con el chef que no lleva ajonjolí.

words.en: Ma'am, the chef will make you a new dish from scratch.
words.es: Señora, el chef le preparará un plato nuevo desde cero.
words.note: Formal usted with the guest.

words.en: I'm asking you to talk it over in private, not in front of the guests.
words.es: Les pido que lo hablemos en privado, no frente a los clientes.

words.en: At 8, we almost served sesame to an allergic guest.
words.es: A las 8, casi le servimos ajonjolí a una clienta alérgica.

words.en: Doña Elena, it was a tough Saturday, but nobody got hurt.
words.es: Doña Elena, fue un sábado difícil, pero nadie salió lastimado.
words.note: Formal; Doña plus first name is respectful in Mexico.

words.en: I would propose reviewing the allergy process with the whole team.
words.es: Le propondría revisar el proceso de alergias con todo el equipo.

lessons.speaking: You are the manager of Los Almendros, and the AI is your team, guests and owner Elena Barrios: train new host Tomás with tú commands, brief the servers with ustedes commands, run the sold-out dinner, then report the day to Elena with past narration, connectors and the conditional.

grammar.focus: Capstone: integrating the Master 20 grammar (connectors, commands, past narration, subjunctive, conditional, formal register)

examples.es: Primero saluda al cliente; después, dale el tiempo estimado.
examples.en: First greet the guest; then give them the estimated time.

examples.es: Recomendaría que el equipo confirmara cada alergia con el chef antes de servir.
examples.en: I would recommend that the team confirm every allergy with the chef before serving.
